wiki.title: Bob Kressig
wiki.extract: Bob Kressig (born December 31, 1953, in Dubuque, Iowa) is the Iowa State Representative from the 75th District. He has served in the Iowa House of Representatives since January 2005. Kressig will retire from the Iowa House at the end of the 2026 legislative session and gave his retirement speech on April 1.
